properties.name: The brainstorm skill connects the dots
properties.rationale:
Anthony gave his word 2026-08-21 on the first of the two halves he named: "the brainstorm skill is the perfect place to start linking ideas. it is like when a person starts 'connecting the dots'."

MEASURED BEFORE BUILDING: 145 brainstormed ideas joined by 12 edges; 111 of them reached no other idea within two hops; the most common edge on an idea was its author.

THE MISSING LEG WAS THE INSTRUCTION, NOT THE TOOL. The connective vocabulary had existed the whole time - twelve wildcard relation types in the inference layer (CONTRADICTS, EVOLVES_INTO, DEPENDS_ON, CAUSES, BLOCKS, DUPLICATES, ANTICIPATES, OBSOLETES, RISKS, MITIGATES, TRIGGERS, VIOLATES), used 81 times across the graph and 29 times between two Decisions - and the brainstorm skill named none of them.

THE SKILL IS THE RIGHT HOME FOR ONE REASON THAT OUTWEIGHS THE OTHERS: the near-matches are already in hand at capture. The skill already requires a search before writing, and the dedup guard already returns the nodes it judged close. That list was read to avoid a duplicate and then discarded, every single time. Linking there costs one judgement, not a pass.

THE STEP TAKES THE THIRD SHAPE rather than either extreme. Merely offering candidates depends on the agent choosing well, which is the status quo that produced 12 edges across 145 ideas. Requiring an edge manufactures relations to satisfy an instruction, and a false neighbour is worse than a missing one because anything that searches by neighbourhood repeats it. So the step asks for the honest edges AND for a written line when none is drawn - the same shape distinct_from already uses on the dedup guard, and the only one of the three that leaves a record of the judgement either way.

DOGFOODED on the idea that produced it, which now carries three edges drawn under the new step.

STILL MISSING: the third leg. Nothing yet notices an idea that names no relation and no line. That detector is what would make this hold across sessions rather than depending on each agent reading the skill.
properties.summary: The brainstorm skill now links each new idea to the ones it actually relates to, and records an explicit line when no relation is honest.
